skills.name: Sword Technique (封阳刀法)
skills.line: Put down your weapon and surrender.
skills.description: Fuuyoukun attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Sword Technique: Cold Snow (封阳刀法・寒雪)
skills.description: Fuuyoukun attacks a single target 2 times, dealing damage equal to 50% of his ATK with each hit and has a 30% base chance to inflict Deep Freeze, lasts for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sword Technique: Clear Sky (封阳刀法・晴空)
skills.description: Fuuyoukun attacks a single target 3 times, dealing damage equal to 25%, 35% and 165% of his ATK with each hit respectively.

skills.name: Leopard's Tactics (龙韬豹略)
skills.line: With the strategies of the Loong and the tactics of the leopard. I ride the wind and move like the cloud.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. When Fuuyoukun attacks a target, they become a Wanted Criminal, lasts for turns. After using his normal attack, he switches to his Cold Snow sword style; after using 望月星河, he switches to his Clear Sky sword style. While the sword style effects are active, his damage reduction is increased by 50%. ;Upon Usage :Fuuyoukun resets his current sword style and increases his move bar by 50%. ;Wanted Criminal (通缉) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': The inflicted target becomes vulnerable to the next attack, their damage received is increased by 50%. ;Cold Snow (寒雪) : :'''General, Mark''': Sword Technique changes to Sword Technique: Cold Snow, 望月星河 changes to 望月星河・雪影. ;Clear Sky (晴空) : :'''General, Mark''': Sword Technique: changes to Sword Technique: Clear Sky, 望月星河 changes to 望月星河・艳阳.

upgrades.text: At the start of battle and after switching sword styles, gains Shelter, lasts for 1 turn.
When his move bar is decreased, he launches a counter-attack on the source of the decrease.
Boost to move bar upon resetting sword styles increases to 75%.
Switching sword styles on turn increases his move bar by 100% (max of once per turn).

skills.name: ? (望月星河)
skills.line: The YLED is ordered to investigate the case.
skills.description: Fuuyoukun attacks all enemies 3 times, dealing damage equal to 25% of his ATK with each hit. ;Freeze Effect (凍結類効果) :When inflicted with effects such as Freeze, Deep Freeze, Frostbound, and Rest in Ice.

upgrades.text: '''望月星河・雪影''': Freeze changes to Deep Freeze.
'''望月星河・艳阳''': Damage for the the 3rd hit increases to 180%.
When an enemy's Freeze Effects are removed, his SPD is increased by 40 (max of 80), lasts for 1 turn

skills.name: Moonlit Stars: Shadowing Snow (望月星河・雪影)
skills.description: Fuuyoukun attacks all enemies 3 times, dealing damage equal to 40% of his ATK with each hit and has a 12% base chance to inflict Freeze , lasts for 1 turn.

skills.name: Moonlit Stars: Bright Sun (望月星河・艳阳)
skills.description: Fuuyoukun attacks all enemies 3 times, dealing damage equal to 25%, 35% and 180% of his ATK with each hit respectively.

bio.condition: With Fuuyoukun win 30 times in PVN zones.
